reason: Direction and all basic operating inputs are causal, but a shared-trunk multi-head model is an empirical architecture rather than a physical residual.

name: forward-reverse compatibility loss
reason: The paper-faithful compatibility equation requires component errors and geometry-specific equivalence parameters, while a target-fitted compatibility relation would not be an independent physical law.

name: global lost-motion latent variable
reason: Paired TE curves expose an offline directional-gap proxy, but no independent global lost-motion measurement identifies the latent state.

name: backlash dead-zone or smooth complementarity residual

name: direction-transition state model
reason: Raw trajectories contain one Fw-to-Bw transition per condition but no repeated loops or deterministic reset contract for trainable state identification.
